schema:name: Coffee Production, Sumatra:
schema:description: This image depicts two people tasting coffee samples for quality control using the cupping technique in Sumatra, Indonesia. Hacienda La Minita serves as Distant Lands Coffee’s green coffee trading division, sourcing specialty coffee from countries such as Ethiopia. Coffee in Ethiopia is grown largely by smallholder farmers and processed at local cooperatives and washing stations.
